To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a novel rule-based NER method, drNER, that can be used to extract knowledge from evidence-based dietary recommendations and that we have evaluated the method by using a text corpus that contains text from several scientifically valid web sites and text extracted from scientific publications.

we have developed a novel method, called drNer, for knowledge extraction from evidence-based dietary recommendations and that drNer can be applied for knowledge extraction from text from heterogeneous sources.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extraction of dietary concepts from text.
the extraction of dietary information and the development of a novel NER for dietary concepts.
knowledge extraction of evidence based dietary information from unstructured texts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
drNER is an effective NER method for knowledge extraction for evidence-based dietary recommendations.
drNER is a promising NER method for extracting dietary information.
drNER gives a good performance and is suitable for knowledge extraction of dietary information.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a novel rule-based NER method for knowledge extraction from the evidence-based dietary information.
drNER is a promising method for knowledge extraction and it can be used as an important tool for dietitians and nutrition researchers.
we have developed a method for extracting dietary concepts from text corpora and we evaluated this method by using text from different sources.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the method can be used for automatic knowledge extraction of evidence based dietary information, and that it can be used to help the process of keeping up with the daily published scientific reports on dietary information.
drNER is a rule based NER that is able to extract dietary information from text.
